<thought>Based on the NMR data, the molecule contains a phenyl ring attached to sulfur (7 aromatic carbons including the carbon bearing S) and an aliphatic chain with one double bond, giving the remaining DBE. Splitting the structure into a phenyl‑thio fragment and an unsaturated alkyl fragment that can be joined through the sulfur yields the fragments: “c1ccc(cc1)S” (phenyl‑S‑) and “CCCCCCCC=C” (alkenyl chain with an open valence at the carbon attached to S). These two fragments together account for C15H22S.</thought>
<final_answer>['c1ccc(cc1)S', 'CCCCCCCC=C']</final_answer>
